title: Number of Strings That Appear as Substrings in Word
summary: Given an array of strings patterns and a string word, count how many strings in patterns are found as a contiguous sequence within word.
statement: Given an array of strings patterns and a string word, count how many strings in patterns are found as a contiguous sequence within word.
constraints: patterns has 1 through 100 lowercase strings of length 1 through 100; duplicates are allowed.
Count each pattern position whose whole string occurs contiguously in word.
reference_solution:
def count_patterns_in_word(patterns, word):
    return sum(pattern in word for pattern in patterns)
